facts.text: Everybody gets a say in here, but I get the last slice of pizza.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Not a line Eddie says in the film. No quote page with Eddie's dialogue could be opened, and nothing in the apple juice write up on Looper matches it. He is the loud one with the opinions, so a written note in his voice fits.
facts.fix: Everybody gets a say in here. I just get the longest one.
